verdict.rationale: Trivy is a CLI security scanner covering vulnerabilities, secrets, misconfigurations, licenses and SBOMs. It has no product-level concept of automations that could be versioned, reviewed, or rolled back, so this axis is a category error for its product type. Any automation around Trivy is user-built, typically in CI, and the commit-hash cache key is an unrelated caching detail.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
